capabilities.unavailableReason: The local daemon is not reachable.
capabilities.substitute: Open Support to repair the daemon connection.

capabilities.unavailableReason: The encrypted database service is not reachable.
capabilities.substitute: Repair the daemon before inspecting local data.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Provider configuration requires the local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Repair the daemon and unlock a supported secret store.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Project state requires the local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Repair the daemon connection.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Mission control requires the local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Repair the daemon connection.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Session ingestion and search require the local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Repair the daemon connection.

capabilities.unavailableReason: The daemon HTTP gateway is disabled or unreachable.
capabilities.substitute: Enable a provider and the loopback gateway in Settings.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Memory review requires the local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Repair the daemon connection.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Browser Computer Use requires a compatible local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Use the approval and audit view after repairing the daemon.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Linux System Computer Use requires a live PipeWire portal capture path and a full input adapter. X11/XTEST covers the complete action set; AT-SPI2 alone is limited to accessible clicks and inspection.
capabilities.substitute: Browser Computer Use remains available when the system prerequisites are not live.

capabilities.unavailableReason: The connected daemon does not expose an available Mercury media runtime.
capabilities.substitute: Pair and control media from a currently supported mobile or macOS client.

capabilities.unavailableReason: A root-owned packaged openburnbar-cli is not available.
capabilities.substitute: Install the full OpenBurnBar package before controlling devices.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Live settings require the local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Use Support to repair the daemon; no settings changes are accepted offline.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Account and sync status require the local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Repair the daemon connection.

capabilities.unavailableReason: The native signed-feed verifier is unavailable.
capabilities.substitute: Verify release signatures manually before installing.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Linux package ownership stays with apt, dnf, or the AppImage owner.
capabilities.substitute: Use the native signed-feed result, then install through the owning package channel.

capabilities.unavailableReason: The current compositor does not expose a safe click-through overlay contract.
capabilities.substitute: Use the contained draggable companion window.

capabilities.unavailableReason: System-wide Linux expansion has no proven IBus or Fcitx adapter.
capabilities.substitute: Use in-app expansion.

capabilities.unavailableReason: secret-tool or the desktop session bus is unavailable.
capabilities.substitute: Install libsecret tools and unlock a Secret Service provider.

capabilities.unavailableReason: kwallet-query or the desktop session bus is unavailable.
capabilities.substitute: Install KWallet or use Secret Service.

capabilities.unavailableReason: No desktop session bus is available for portal negotiation.
capabilities.substitute: Use an X11 session only for workflows with an explicit safe fallback.

capabilities.unavailableReason: The desktop tray host did not accept the OpenBurnBar status item.
capabilities.substitute: Use the main window.

capabilities.unavailableReason: Notification delivery requires the local daemon.
capabilities.substitute: Use the in-app activity view.
